::: {#sol-best-constant}

In @eq-constant-prediction-decompose,
the first term, $\Var{Y}$, does not depend on $c$.
The second term, $\sqf{\mean - c}$, is a [square](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-square),
so it is never negative,
and it is zero exactly when $c = \mean$.
So

$$
\begin{aligned}
c &= \mean \\
&= \E{Y}
\end{aligned}
$$

minimizes the [expected squared error](expectation.qmd#def-squared-error-risk),
and no other number does.
The [set of minimizers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-argmin)
has the single element $\mean$.

:::
